spec.requirement: Use the approved pilot/normalize.py unchanged. Implement pilot/report.py with report_counts(values) that calls normalize_counts and returns deterministic compact JSON with exactly count,total,maximum keys sorted lexicographically, no whitespace or trailing newline. Propagate normalize_counts validation errors and preserve input. Create pilot/verify_report.py using unittest for empty input, multiple integers, exact JSON format/key order, invalid types including bool, negative input, and immutability. Use standard library only. Only report.py and verify_report.py may change; do not modify normalize.py or verify.py.
